name: Crucible Genomics BioSec Full Tactical Kit
description: Deep viridian and bone-white hard-shell armor over adaptive bioweave fatigues, marked with Crucible's double-helix sigil in bioluminescent jade across the chest plate and helmet. The full-face respirator helmet integrates gene-scan optics and airborne pathogen filters rated for Level-4 containment breaches. Load-bearing vest carries specimen containment pouches, breach charges, and a corded med-injector rail. Boots are sealed biosafe rubber over composite toe, chemical-resistant to Crucible's own experimental compounds.
functionality: Provides Level-4 pathogen containment, gene-scan HUD integration, and chemical resistance rated for Crucible laboratory breach scenarios.
what_it_says: You are Crucible's property first, a soldier second — deployed to protect assets that bleed profit.
story_hooks: A BioSec operative's helmet gene-scanner flags a civilian as an escaped proprietary geneline — someone is walking around with Crucible IP written into their DNA.
The kit's containment pouches hold something that isn't a specimen — it's a keycard and a handwritten note.
